results.title: 'Once Predicted No One Would Hold Tricolour in J&K, Today It Flies High': LG Sinha Takes Swipe at Mehbooba
results.description: Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha took an apparent swipe at former Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti over her past remarks on the Tricolour, saying the national flag is today being held high with pride across Jammu and Kashmir. He also called for a united societal effort to combat terrorism, narco-terrorism, substance abuse and corruption.
